notes.en: Frozen pure-standard-library citation scripts qualified in the real Floe TinyEMU Linux 6.18.56/riscv64 guest with Python 3.13.5. Offline golden workloads and source-preservation gates passed; the live DOI registration check passed with actual Crossref 404 reported as metadata unavailable; a separate offline workload verified two real DOIs with no failures and no invented metadata. No third-party package provisioning was required. This is component execution evidence: App-specific native PDF export, model-driven end-to-end work and physical-device behavior were not exercised. Retained evidence distinguishes the pre-marker driver-log prefix from the final full-log manifest; no findings or execution assertions were normalized away. Existing reviewed tools and capabilities are unchanged.
notes.zh-Hans: 冻结的纯标准库引文脚本已在真实 Floe TinyEMU Linux 6.18.56/riscv64、Python 3.13.5 客体完成运行鉴定。离线黄金用例和源文件保护检查通过；真实联网 DOI 注册核验通过，Crossref 实际返回 404 时如实标注元数据不可用；另一个离线工作负载核验两个真实 DOI，无失败、无编造元数据。无需安装第三方包。此为组件执行证明；未在本轮验证 App 原生 PDF 导出、模型驱动的完整任务或真机行为。保留证据分别绑定标记前的驱动日志前缀及最终完整日志清单，未归一化掉检查结果或执行断言。原审核工具和能力保持不变。
